Like other airlines when we departed there were no instructions on safety of seat belts and no announcement of take off and landing ,there were many passengers in the flight who were first time travellers and did not even know how to put a seat belt. There was no service in the aircraft my mother needed water and inspite of ringing the bell many times no flight attendant ,responded and attended us or any other passengers. We are paying the fare and travelling and not for free so why this kind of behaviour by Iraq Air staff. They were occupying the first row aisle seats both ways instead of giving it to the older passengers with leg problems and just busy talking amongst themselves in the flight as well at the airport. Why is it always that the first row aisle seats are occupied by the Iraq Air staff instead of the senior passengers with leg problems. And yes we had booked a wheelchair throughout both ways and the wheel chair was not available and not attempted to be provided at Mumbai airport on departure or at Najaf airport on landing my mother with a leg problem had to walk all the way out on landing at the Najaf airport on 24th Oct. reviews.title: never travel by iraqi airways rip you off
reviews.text: We left on the IAIO266Y flight to Erbil at 9:30pm 5/9/2019. We checked in with our luggage and showed that two of the female passengers also held a small handbags with them, we showed this at the check in with no problem. When at the gate to board in, one of the female passengers went on board with another family to help them since the family was of one mother and 3 children. When my self and my wife went to the gate to board they stopped us, telling us we had to pay £50 extra for the handbag witch was our daughters handbag we were holding for her. They told us we either had to pay £50 cash or they would throw out things away or they would not let us board the plane. They would not accept my card payment at all, even though that's what I wanted to pay with. They also refused to give us any receipt. We spoke to the sir whom we had checked in with, but he was of no help. The man who stopped us was tall and dark skinned, aged 50+, had a big figure, and you could tell he was in charge. Never travel by iraqi airways again.

reviews.title: How Can Iraqi Airlines Improve Their Service
reviews.text: Dear Iraqi Airways, Greetings from your traveler bearing ETK 0723412044953C2, from Najaf to Mumbai! Flight No. IA447, Class Y, Date 12 Sep, Departure 2100, Name of Passenger Nasrulla/Farazdak, Seat 5E I would like to thank the Captain of that Aircraft who brought us back safely to our destination. The best part of the airlines was it was a non-stop flight which made our journey comfortable. The dinner served was fabulous. This journey could have been fabulous if the following were also taken care of: 1. Blankets provided for each and every passenger 2. Headphones to be made available in the aircraft, as there were Video screens but no headphones 3. It would be good if the Airhostess or the Stewards would be prompt to reply to the "Flight Attendant" button when pressed and not be made to wait for more than 15 minutes or more 4. I assume the flight to be a non-smoking flight 5. It took the Steward 20 minutes to serve me water after take-off, and also after the seat belt sign was not active Najaf Airport could have 2 additions to help their passengers: 1. WiFi made available for Free for atleast 60 minutes, and 2. Drinking water made available to drink. The water that was available at the airport was chargeable - 1000 Dinars I hope the above will be taken positively, and for the betterment of the Airlines, so that Iraqi Airlines can be the Number One in the world, and put other airlines that rank on the top, below it. reviews.title: BEST VALUE, NO FRILLS, DIFFICULT TRAVEL TIMES
reviews.text: The good side is that heading to Baghdad, it is a direct flight, unlike the return flight that stops in Sofia, Bulgaria and requires full disembarking and security controls. You lose two hours in this process. The fare is reasonable unlike many other carriers as well as those with more stop-overs and delays, so although it arrives in Baghdad at dawn, the day ahead is yours after a VERY short night with the time difference and little chance of adequate sleep. Well, that is travel for you! The onboard food was OK in both directions, although there is no alcohol as Iraq has fallen under Islamic law, unlike during the decades before regime change.
reviews.author: Sheri Laizer

reviews.title: Overall good flights
reviews.text: I have travelled from Berlin to Erbil (return) beginning of May. I felt well looked after in both flights. The flights itself went well - all on time and smooth start and landing. The service was friendly and the food was good and tasty. Only the interior needs a refurbishment (I caught one of the older planes), but I am sure that's on the way. Overall I am quite happy and would fly with them again.

If i could i would have given it ZERO out of 5.

So as my mam got to the top of the aisle he rudely exclaimed to my mum, “EXCUSE, MOVE MADAM. I’VE COME ALL THE WAY FROM IRAQ FOR YOU, I’M TIRED!” And a few more words which I cannot remember. This left my mum very upset and hurt. Staff cannot speak like this whatever he problem. Also, there wasn’t not 1 bit of flight entertainment and my 2 young children who are 1 & 2 year old, were extremely bored even though they had their own entertainment. Considering the flight is a direct flight and consists of around 6 or more hours, which is technically a long-haul flight, they should have in-flight entertainment.
